title: Ok, good amount for the price, but poorly made.
text: Ok, good amount for the price, but poorly made.. Despite coming in a 3 package and wide array of colours/looks, I did not like these as much as others I bought here as well. The sparkling parts were very uneven, almost as if painted by a child, with a lot of mistakes from not having dried properly, or from being done in a hurry, they were obviously done by hand but are lacking a lot in quality. The glitter is obviously all over the place and I liked the fact they are very christmasy and cute but overall I'm not so sure they were worth it afterall. In the end they were good tree fillers but did not stand out much on their own.
